You are documenting the UI-build patterns that PR #59 (global footer UI) established in this repository. Work strictly from the merged code — OBSERVED PRACTICE ONLY, with `file:line` evidence for every claim. Do not infer intent, do not judge quality, do not compare to anything.

REPO: /Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa
PR #59 merged as commit `8362b3c` on `develop`. The pre-merge base is `cd68e97`.
Useful starting point: `git diff --name-status cd68e97 8362b3c -- overrides .claude` (94 commits of work).

READ (in full where small, representatively where large):
- overrides/app/components/footer/** (index.tsx, footer.css.ts, footerNavColumn/, bottomBar/)
- overrides/app/components/ui-kits/** (atoms zimmButton, zimmIcon, zimmLogo, zimmModal, zimmNavItem, zimmTextInput; molecules zimmContactIconRow, zimmInputAction; organisms zimmSubscribeModal, zimmSubscribeSection)
- overrides/app/theme/components/index.ts, recipeGuards.test.ts, header.ts, listMenu.ts, footerShared.ts
- overrides/app/hooks/ (useUiCopy.ts, useSubscribeSection.*, useZimmModal.*, useCountryConfig.*, useContentfulClient.*)
- overrides/app/utils/safeHref.ts, resolveByRegion.ts
- overrides/app/components/uiCopyProvider/**
- overrides/app/theme/fontFace.tsx
- .claude/rules/*.md  (these were revised by #59 — note what changed in them)

DOCUMENT each pattern under these headings. For every pattern give: what it is, at least one `file:line` citation, and how consistently it is applied (all sites / most / one-off).

1. STYLING SURFACE — where does styling live? co-located `<name>.css.ts` vs `theme/components/<name>.ts`; how recipes are registered; single-part vs multipart (`parts`); how variants/state are expressed; use of `var(--zimm-*)` vs bare Chakra token keys vs `textStyle`; any use of raw literals and how they are justified in comments.
2. COMPONENT STRUCTURE — the atom/molecule/organism split as actually practised; what qualifies for each tier; folder layout; export style (named vs default); props typing and where prop types live; JSDoc practice.
3. DATA FLOW — container vs presentational; which components call hooks; where fetching happens; how state is extracted into custom hooks and when; how props cross composition boundaries.
4. MICROCOPY & CONTENT — `useUiCopy` usage, key naming, fallback handling; when `useIntl` is used instead; how the two coexist.
5. TESTING — what gets a `*.test.ts(x)` vs a Storybook `play` vs both; how mocking is scoped; the `ZimmIcon` mock workaround; what `recipeGuards.test.ts` actually enforces (read the test body, list each guard); any vacuity/self-test guards.
6. STORYBOOK — story file structure, `title` categorisation actually used, named exports, when `play` is added, decorators, a11y handling.
7. ACCESSIBILITY — concrete practices visible in the code (aria attributes, focus handling, target sizes, semantics).
8. OVERRIDES — how #59 handles importing an already-overridden component; relative vs `@salesforce/retail-react-app/...` paths; any comment explaining the resolver.
9. TOKENS — which foundation scales are registered vs not, and how the code compensates; where `var(--zimm-*)` is mandatory.

HARD CONSTRAINTS
- READ-ONLY. Do not write, create or modify any file. Do not run git commands that mutate state (no checkout, no stash, no commit) — read-only git (`git show`, `git diff`, `git log`) is fine.
- Every claim needs a `file:line`. A claim you cannot cite must be labelled "UNCITED — inference".
- Where a pattern is applied inconsistently, say so explicitly and cite both the majority and the exception. Inconsistency is itself a finding I need.
- Do not read anything under /Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/ outside the repo.

Return the pattern catalogue as your final report.

    17	// Contentful resolves nested references `include` levels deep, and the footer model is exactly
    18	// three: footerConfig → navGroups (1) → links (2) → regions (3). Depth 3 is the minimum that
    19	// populates `entry.fields.regions[].fields.siteId`, which isEligible reads.

    23	// — `withoutUnresolvableLinks` is not passed), so `region.fields.siteId` throws, the `.catch`

    41	   */
    42	  enableNameCapture?: boolean;

    45	  onLogoClick?: () => void;

    56	 * nothing, matching every other Contentful-backed component in the repo (`DuplexSection`,

    60	 * zimmSubscribeSection, ui-kits/molecules/zimmContactIconRow via FooterNavColumn) rather than

   commerce SDK hooks — the reasoning is the same either way: a component that owns its own
   data-fetching can't be reused somewhere the data arrives differently (SSR-prefetched,
   mocked in Storybook, composed from a parent that already has it).
+
+  **Exception — Context-backed, app-wide static-content hooks** (`useIntl`, `useUiCopy`) may
+  be called from any component, including presentational leaves. Both read from a Provider
+  mounted above the route tree, not from a per-page/per-component fetch — so calling one from
+  a leaf doesn't create the SSR/Storybook/parent-composition problem the rule above exists to
+  prevent, and doesn't multiply fetches the way an SDK hook would. `useUiCopy`
+  (`overrides/app/hooks/useUiCopy.ts`, Provider at `overrides/app/components/uiCopyProvider/`)
+  is the reference example — `BottomBar` and `ZimmSubscribeSection` both call it directly
+  for microcopy while still receiving their actual business data as props. This exception is
+  narrow: it covers content that is identical for every consumer regardless of route/context,
+  not anything that varies per page.
+
+  **Their no-Provider behaviour differs, and it matters for tests and stories.** `useUiCopy`
+  degrades to fallback text — `useContext(UiCopyContext) ?? FALLBACK_ONLY` — so a leaf calling
+  it renders with zero setup. `useIntl` **throws** (`react-intl`'s `invariantIntlContext`:
+  _"Could not find required `intl` object"_), and its `IntlProvider` is mounted by the **base
+  SFCC `_app`**, not by `_app-config` — a strictly narrower subtree. `.storybook/preview.tsx`
+  supplies one for stories precisely because of this; any Vitest test rendering a `useIntl`
+  consumer must wrap it too. An earlier revision of this paragraph claimed both hooks degrade
+  gracefully and that both Providers sit in `_app-config`; neither is true of `useIntl`.
 - **Extract-to-hook threshold.** Pull inline component logic out into a custom hook
   (`overrides/app/hooks/use<ComponentName><Feature>.ts`) when either is true:

diff --git a/.claude/rules/frozenFiles.md b/.claude/rules/frozenFiles.md
index 2cf0996..08e49a0 100644
--- a/.claude/rules/frozenFiles.md
+++ b/.claude/rules/frozenFiles.md
@@ -24,16 +24,27 @@ overrides/app/theme/foundation/sizes.ts
 overrides/app/theme/foundation/zimmTokens.ts
 ```
 
-**No font binaries in this repo.** Futura Round ships under a Monotype *"Font Software For
-Desktop End User License Agreement"* which forbids "further distribute the Font Software, or
-any copy thereof" and "Install the Font Software on any server or in any digital asset
-management system" — so `.woff2`/`.otf` must not be committed here or served from the MRT CDN.
-Licence: Zimmermann-Handover repo, `02-design/library/assets/Font Futura WOFF2/Licenses/2275/`.
-Type renders from the fallback stack in `foundation/fonts.ts`. Self-hosting needs Zimmermann's
-own Monotype Web Page Content entitlement (2 fonts: Regular 400, Medium 500).
-
-Per-component theme overrides live in `overrides/app/theme/components/` and are
-**Tier 2** — see [protectedFiles.md](./protectedFiles.md). `overrides/app/theme/globalStyles.ts`
+**Fonts are self-hosted and served on every tier.** `overrides/app/static/fonts/` holds two
+Futura Round faces — Regular 400 and Medium 500 — declared by
+`overrides/app/theme/fontFace.tsx` and mounted in both `_app-config/index.tsx` and
+`.storybook/preview.tsx`. Only two faces exist because only two are used: all 22 textStyles
+resolve to fontWeight 400 or 500, and `fonts.body === fonts.heading`.
+
+There is **no environment gate** on this, and it is worth stating plainly because an earlier
+revision of this section claimed there was. `ZimmFontFace` mounts unconditionally inside
+`_app-config`'s `ChakraProvider`, and `pwa-kit-dev`'s `staticFolderCopyPlugin` copies
+`overrides/app/static` in both the client and SSR webpack configs — so the `.woff2` are
+published with every bundle and shoppers on every storefront render Futura Round.
+
+`foundation/fonts.ts` already lists `'Futura Round'` first in both stacks, so the `@font-face`
+declaration is the only thing that makes it resolve — no component, recipe or token changes.
+The fallback stack renders roughly 13% wider, which is why serving the real faces matters for
 ```

=====theme/index.ts
     1	/**
     2	 * Zimmermann custom Chakra UI theme.
     3	 *
     4	 * This file composes the theme from `foundation/` (brand tokens) and
     5	 * `components/` (per-component overrides). Add a new component override by
     6	 * creating a file in `components/` and registering it in `components/index.ts`.
     7	 *
     8	 * Usage:
     9	 *   import theme from 'overrides/app/theme'
    10	 *   <ChakraProvider theme={theme}>…</ChakraProvider>
    11	 *
    12	 * Extend via extendTheme() — see Chakra UI docs:
    13	 * https://chakra-ui.com/docs/styled-system/customize-theme
    14	 */
    15	import baseTheme from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/theme';
    16	import { extendTheme, type ThemeOverride } from '@chakra-ui/react';
    17	import { borderWidths, breakpoints, colors, fonts, spacing, textStyles } from './foundation';
    18	import { components } from './components';
    19	import { globalStyles } from './globalStyles';
    20	
    21	// Note: --zimm-* CSS custom properties are injected onto :root via a raw
    22	// <Global> in _app-config/index.tsx (ZimmTokensGlobal). They cannot go through
    23	// Chakra's styles.global because Chakra's style processor strips quotes from
    24	// font-family values like "'Futura Round', sans-serif", outputting just "sans-serif".
    25	//
    26	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    27	// Which foundations are registered as Chakra scales, and which are not
    28	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    29	// Registered below: borderWidths, breakpoints, colors, fonts, space, textStyles.
    30	//
    31	// Deliberately NOT registered, because the Zimmermann scale and the Chakra scale
    32	// use the same key names for different values — remapping them would silently
    33	// restyle the base retail-react-app, which uses those names at ~199 call sites:
    34	//
    35	//   fontSizes    Chakra md=16px xs=12px 2xs=10px 3xs=7.2px
    36	//                Zimmermann md=24px xs=16px 2xs=14px 3xs=12px  (4 collisions)
    37	//   transition   Chakra duration.fast=150ms slow=300ms
    38	//                Zimmermann fast=200ms default=300ms slow=500ms
    39	//   sizes        Chakra sizes.lg=32rem vs iconSizes.lg=20px
    40	//
    41	// Set type with `textStyle` (all 22 Handover text styles are registered), never a
    42	// raw `fontSize` token. For motion, icon and action dimensions, import the
    43	// constants from `foundation/` directly — the pattern component overrides already
    44	// use for FONT_MEDIUM. `theme/index.test.tsx` guards these scales against being
    45	// remapped by a future change.
    46	//
    47	// The 15 numeric `--zimm-scale-NNN` aliases are duplicates of the named scale
    48	// (400 = 16px = `m`) and exist only for the .zimm-* global classes; the named
    49	// scale is the Chakra-facing surface.
    50	
    51	const overrides: ThemeOverride = {
    52	  borderWidths,
    53	  breakpoints,
    54	  colors,
    55	  fonts,
    56	  space: spacing,
    57	  textStyles,
    58	  components,
    59	  styles: {
    60	    global: globalStyles,
    61	  },
    62	};
    63	
    64	const theme = extendTheme(baseTheme, overrides);
    65	
    66	export default theme;
=====foundation/sizes.ts
     1	// Icon sizes — source: Zimmermann Design System 2026 (Handover tokens.md § Icon Sizes)
     2	//
     3	// Deliberately NOT registered as `theme.sizes`. Chakra's `sizes.lg` is 32rem and
     4	// backs every `w`/`h`/`boxSize` token across the base retail-react-app, so
     5	// remapping these names would resize base components. Import these constants
     6	// directly instead — the same pattern component overrides already use for
     7	// FONT_MEDIUM: `<Icon boxSize={iconSizes.lg} />`.
     8	export const iconSizes = {
     9	  lg: '20px',
    10	  md: '16px',
    11	  sm: '12px',
    12	} as const;
    13	
    14	// Action (button) sizing — source: Handover tokens/spacing.css (--zimm-size-action-*).
    15	// The CSS-var twins already exist in zimmTokens.ts. These are the Handover-correct
    16	// values; zimmButton.css.ts (the single source of truth for actual button styling — no
    17	// .zimm-btn-* class duplicates it) currently uses different prototype values for
    18	// height (BTN_HEIGHT_LG/SM), flagged there pending UI-designer sign-off.
    19	export const actionSizes = {
    20	  height: {
    21	    lg: '52px',
    22	    md: '40px',
    23	  },
    24	  paddingX: {
    25	    lg: '32px',
    26	    md: '20px',
    27	  },
    28	  gap: '16px',
    29	} as const;

content.content: 1 # Components, Hooks & Storybook 2 3 Everything about designing, structuring, and presenting a React component or hook in this 4 project. Split out of [conventions.md](./conventions.md) — see that file for cross-cutting 5 rules that apply to every file regardless of type (TypeScript-only, DRY/KISS/SOLID, magic 6 numbers, security). TypeScript idioms live in [typescript.md](./typescript.md); Chakra/CSS 7 conventions live in [css.md](./css.md). 8 9 --- 10 11 ## Components 12 13 - **Named export** matches the folder name (e.g. `productTile/` exports `ProductTile`). 14 No default exports of anonymous functions. 15 - **Props type name** matches the component name: `ProductTileProps` for `ProductTile`, 16 `TopNavProps` for `TopNav`. 17 - **Props type placement:** 18 - _Default:_ declare the `Props` type at the top of the component file. 19 - _Move to `types.ts` in the same folder_ only when (a) the type is consumed by sibling 20 files (story, test, sub-components) **or** (b) it exceeds ~30 lines and mixes with 21 other shared types worth co-locating. 22 - The trigger is _shared consumption_, not line count alone. 23 - **JSDoc** is required on: 24 25 - Any component used by ≥2 callers (shared components — typically Tier 2 in 26 [protectedFiles.md](./protectedFiles.md)). 27 - Any exported hook. 28 - Any utility function with non-obvious behaviour. 29 30 Leaf components used by a single page don't need JSDoc — the prop type is sufficient. 31 32 - **Callback props** follow `onEventName` (e.g. `onAddToCart`, `onClose`). 33 - **Required props are non-optional;** optional props use `?` — no `| undefined` unions 34 for "I forgot to mark it optional." 35 - **Accessibility (JSX) — mechanically enforced by `.coderabbit/ast-grep-rules/`, so get 36 these right at authoring time:** 37 - Every `` needs an `alt` attribute (`alt=""` is fine for purely decorative images). 38 - Every `IconButton` (including wrapped variants like `IconButtonWithRegistration`) needs 39 an `aria-label` — it renders no visible text, so screen readers have nothing else to 40 announce. 41 - Any element with an `onClick` that isn't natively interactive (`div`, `span`, `Box`, 42 `Flex`, `Stack`, `VStack`, `HStack`, `Grid`, `Text`, and similar) needs a `role` 43 attribute at minimum — and for real keyboard operability, also `tabIndex={0}` and an 44 `onKeyDown` handler (or just use a `Button`/native interactive element instead, which 45 is almost always simpler than reimplementing keyboard behaviour). ==== 105-180 ==== 1 2 ## Hooks 3 4 - **File extension** is `.ts` (no JSX in a hook file). 5 - **Exported function name** matches the filename: `useWishlist.ts` exports `useWishlist`. 6 - **Parameters and return value are typed** — no implicit `any`, no missing return type. 7 See [typescript.md](./typescript.md) for the general typing rules this extends. 8 - **JSDoc** is required on every exported hook, including a `@returns` description. 9 10 --- 11 12 ## Storybook 13 14 Storybook is the canonical place to view components in isolation. Keep it browsable — 15 a flat 200-story sidebar is unusable. 16 17 ### When a story is required 18 19 - **Required** for any component exported from its folder under `overrides/app/components/` 20 or `overrides/app/pages/` (i.e. anything another file imports). 21 - **Not required** for purely internal sub-components that only render inside one parent 22 (e.g. `productTile/priceRow.tsx` used only by `productTile/index.tsx`). Cover their 23 variants via the parent's stories. 24 - Pages get a story showing the full assembly with representative props — not a story per 25 sub-section. 26 27 ### Categorisation 28 29 Story `title` drives the sidebar tree. Pick the first matching category: 30 31 | Category | What goes here | 32 | ------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | 33 | `Foundation/` | Design tokens — Colour, Typography, Spacing, Icons, Shadows | 34 | `Elements/` | Generic building blocks — both display (Badge, Tag, Link, Avatar, Skeleton) and interactive controls (Button, Input, Checkbox, Select). Tiebreaker: _can it be used outside a form?_ → `Elements/`. | 35 | `Layout/` | Global chrome, navigation, and structural components — Header, Footer, DrawerMenu, ListMenu, Breadcrumb, Pagination, Seo | 36 | `Commerce/` | Commerce-specific shared components — ProductTile, OrderSummary, PromoCode, DisplayPrice, SwatchGroup | 37 | `Forms/` | Composed form assemblies — AddressForm, CheckoutContactForm, NewsletterSignup | 38 | `Pages/` | Full page assemblies — PDP, PLP, Cart, Checkout, Account | 39 | `Contentful/` | CMS-driven components — HeroBanner, RichText, ContentBlock. Use mock Contentful data in stories so variants are visible without a live CMS connection. | 40 41 Naming convention: singular for a concept or proper noun (`Foundation`, `Commerce`, `Layout`, `Contentful`); plural for a collection (`Elements`, `Forms`, `Pages`). 42 43 Examples: 44 45 ```ts 46 export default { title: 'Commerce/ProductTile' }; // ✅ 47 export default { title: 'Layout/Header' }; // ✅ 48 export default { title: 'Elements/Button' }; // ✅ 49 export default { title: 'Pages/PDP' }; // ✅ 50 export default { title: 'Elements/DisplayPrice' }; // ❌ — eCommerce specific, use Commerce/ 51 export default { title: 'Primitives/Button' }; // ❌ — use Elements/ 52 ``` 53 54 When in doubt: ask "what does this component _know_ about?" Commerce → `Commerce/`, 55 CMS-driven → `Contentful/`, nothing domain-specific → `Elements/`, page-level composition → `Pages/`. 56 57 ### Story content 58 59 - Every story file has a `Default` named export. 60 - Add named exports for meaningful states (`Loading`, `OutOfStock`, `WithDiscount`) — not 61 for every possible prop combination. 62 - `play` functions only when there's interactive behaviour worth asserting; otherwise the 63 story is purely visual.

# PR #59 (global footer UI) — Observed Pattern Catalogue

Scope: files added/modified by `cd68e97..8362b3c`. All line numbers are from the current working tree, which is byte-identical to `8362b3c` for every file cited **except** `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/theme/components/index.ts` (grown by 8 lines post-merge; I cite the merge-commit form where it matters and say so).

---

## 1. STYLING SURFACE

**1.1 Co-located `<name>.css.ts` is the default; `theme/components/<name>.ts` is the residue.**
Every recipe #59 authored lives beside its component: `overrides/app/components/footer/footer.css.ts:20`, `.../footer/bottomBar/bottomBar.css.ts:3`, `.../footer/footerNavColumn/footerNavColumn.css.ts:3`, `.../ui-kits/atoms/zimmButton/zimmButton.css.ts:243`, `.../ui-kits/atoms/zimmModal/zimmModal.css.ts:5`, `.../ui-kits/atoms/zimmNavItem/zimmNavItem.css.ts:74`, `.../ui-kits/atoms/zimmTextInput/zimmTextInput.css.ts:77`, `.../ui-kits/molecules/zimmContactIconRow/zimmContactIconRow.css.ts:1`, `.../ui-kits/organisms/zimmSubscribeModal/zimmSubscribeModal.css.ts:3`, `.../ui-kits/organisms/zimmSubscribeSection/zimmSubscribeSection.css.ts:14`. **10 of 10.** What stays in `theme/components/` is only: base-SFCC partial overrides (`header.ts:5`, `listMenu.ts:6`) and one cross-file shared-values module (`footerShared.ts:18,28`). `theme/components/button.ts` was **deleted** and became `ui-kits/atoms/zimmButton/zimmButton.css.ts` (`git diff --name-status cd68e97 8362b3c` shows `D overrides/app/theme/components/button.ts`).

**1.2 Registration is always central, regardless of file location.** Every recipe is imported into `overrides/app/theme/components/index.ts` and spread into one `components` object (merge-commit form: imports at lines 1–12, map at lines 14–27; working tree: lines 1–12 and 18–35). `overrides/app/theme/index.ts:58` passes `components` to `extendTheme(baseTheme, overrides)` at line 64. **All sites.** The rule text was updated to say co-location is "purely an organisational choice with no runtime difference" (`.claude/rules/overrideStyling.md:198-206`).

**1.3 Multipart (`parts`) vs single-part is decided by whether the component renders one element or several.**
- Multipart plain objects with a literal `parts: [...]` array, consumed via `useMultiStyleConfig`: `footer.css.ts:21`, `bottomBar.css.ts:4`, `footerNavColumn.css.ts:4`, `zimmModal.css.ts:6`, `zimmTextInput.css.ts:78`, `zimmContactIconRow.css.ts:2`, `zimmSubscribeModal.css.ts:4`, `zimmSubscribeSection.css.ts:15`. **8 of 10.**
- Single-part via `defineStyleConfig`, consumed via `useStyleConfig` or Chakra's own `<Button>`: `zimmButton.css.ts:1,243`, `zimmNavItem.css.ts:1,74`. **2 of 10.**

## 2. COMPONENT STRUCTURE

**2.1 `ui-kits/{atoms,molecules,organisms}/` is created wholesale by #59.** `git ls-tree -r cd68e97 -- overrides/app/components/ui-kits` returns nothing. The tier boundary as actually practised:
- **Atom** = one visual primitive, no composition of other Zimmermann components except `ZimmIcon`: `zimmButton`, `zimmIcon`, `zimmLogo`, `zimmModal`, `zimmNavItem`, `zimmTextInput`.
- **Molecule** = composes ≥2 atoms or an atom + repeated markup, still stateless-ish: `zimmContactIconRow` (composes `ZimmIcon` — `zimmContactIconRow/index.tsx:3`), `zimmInputAction` (composes `ZimmTextInput` + `ZimmButton` — `zimmInputAction/index.tsx:3-4`).
- **Organism** = owns a state machine or a dialog flow and calls hooks: `zimmSubscribeSection` (calls `useSubscribeSection` + `useUiCopy` — `zimmSubscribeSection/index.tsx:47,52`), `zimmSubscribeModal` (calls `useZimmModal` — `zimmSubscribeModal/index.tsx:36`).
- Counter-observation: `ZimmModal` calls `createPortal` and takes `mounted`/`labelledBy` (`zimmModal/index.tsx:2,50`) yet sits in `atoms/` — it is classified by "owns no content", stated at `zimmModal/index.tsx:26-29`.

**2.2 Footer-internal sub-components live under `footer/`, not `ui-kits/`,** when only the footer can use them: `footer/bottomBar/index.tsx`, `footer/footerNavColumn/index.tsx`. **5.4 `recipeGuards.test.ts` — what it actually enforces (six tests).** File: `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/theme/components/recipeGuards.test.ts`.

Mechanism first: `collect()` (line 263) iterates `Object.entries(components)` — the registered recipe map — and for each recipe walks `resolveAllBaseStyles(r)` plus `r.variants` and `r.sizes` (lines 267-272) with a recursive `walk` (line 191) that descends media queries, pseudo-selectors and responsive containers, carrying the nearest enclosing property name forward. `isResponsiveContainer` (line 181) requires **all** keys to be breakpoints, load-bearing because `xl`/`2xl`/`sm`/`md`/`lg` are keys in both `breakpoints` and `spacing`/`fontSizes` (lines 170-175). A function-form `baseStyle` is resolved across **all 2^5 = 32** boolean prop combinations (`PROP_COMBINATIONS`, lines 236-243), because a value branch (`top: floated ? '3xs' : '50%'`) is invisible under the all-false default — the comment at lines 231-234 records that `'3xs'` shipped exactly that way. Results are deduplicated (lines 274-283).

1. **`collect() actually walks the registered recipes`** (line 287) — the **vacuity guard**. Asserts `Object.keys(components).length > 0` and `collect().length > 0`. Comment at lines 288-290: "Every other test here asserts an empty offender list, which an empty input satisfies just as well as a clean one. Without this, deleting `components` would turn the whole file green."
2. **`no sizing property uses a bare spacing-scale key`** (line 295) — `SIZING_PROPS` (width/height/min/max/boxSize/w/h/minW/maxW/minH/maxH, lines 118-132) × `SPACING_KEYS`. Catches `width: 'xl'` resolving to Chakra's `sizes.xl` = 36rem. This is the bug that shipped a 576px icon (header comment lines 9-13; the surviving countermeasure is visible at `zimmContactIconRow.css.ts:12-16`).
3. **`no typography property uses a bare scale key`** (line 305) — `TYPOGRAPHY_PROPS` map (lines 153-157) covering `fontSize`/`lineHeight`/`letterSpacing`, each against its own Zimmermann keys ∪ spacing keys. `fontWeight` is deliberately excluded because `medium` resolves to 500 in both scales (lines 149-151).
4. **`no compound shorthand contains a bare scale key`** (line 315) — for `padding`/`margin`/`inset`/`gap`/`p`/`m` only (`SPACE_SHORTHANDS`, line 160), splits the value on whitespace *outside* `var(...)` (line 321) and flags any part that is a spacing key. Catches `padding: 'xs 0'`, which the browser drops entirely.
5. **`no override-component style uses a bare token key on a registered scale`** (line 331) — the **house-style** guard, over `SPACE_PROPS` (44 entries, lines 70-113) and `COLOR_PROPS` (8 entries, line 116) against `SPACING_KEYS` and a recursively-flattened dotted `COLOR_KEYS` set (lines 60-66). Explicitly **not** a correctness bug (lines 28-34, 339-343): `space` and `colors` are registered, so the bare key resolves fine — it enforces `var(--zimm-*)` at every call site so reviewers don't have to consult the registered-scale list.
6. **`no recipe silently inherits a base SFCC recipe of the same name`** (line 347) — since `extendTheme` deep-merges, a recipe named `Footer` would inherit SFCC's `Footer`. Compares each recipe's own `baseStyle` keys against the composed `theme.components[name]` keys; any key present after composition that wasn't declared came from the base. `INTENTIONAL_MERGES = ['Button', 'Header', 'ListMenu']` (line 351) is the allow-list — everything else must be namespaced, which is why the recipes are `ZimmFooter`, `ZimmFooterNavColumn`, `ZimmFooterBottomBar` and not `Footer`.

**Self-declared blind spots**, written into the file header (lines 36-43): the walk sees the recipe map only, so it cannot catch the same mistakes as a JSX prop. Two live instances are named — `overrides/app/components/header/index.tsx:302` (`fontSize="l"`, emits nothing) and a former bare `paddingLeft: '2xs'` in `footerNavColumn/index.tsx`'s inline `sx` merge that "was only found by a manual grep".

**5.5 Other vacuity/anchoring guards.**
- `footer/index.stories.tsx:231-237` — anchors both operands of a before/after height comparison above zero, with the reasoning that `display:none`, `height:0`, and jsdom all measure 0 twice and would satisfy the equality vacuously.
- `footer/index.stories.tsx:113-117` — reads `document.body.style.overflow` before the modal opens and asserts it is *not already* `hidden`, so the scroll-lock assertion can't pass trivially.
- `footer/index.stories.tsx:255-259` — rounds `getBoundingClientRect` to 1dp to avoid sub-pixel jitter failing a genuine no-shift.
- `zimmTextInput.css.test.ts:81-84` — asserts every declared `parts` entry is actually produced by `baseStyle`.
- `zimmTextInput.css.test.ts:41-46` — tests the *empty-and-focused* case specifically, because focus and filled resolve to the same colour in the light palette and only that case distinguishes "the focus branch ran" from "fell through to default".

## 7. ACCESSIBILITY

**7.1 Landmark and dialog semantics.** `<chakra.footer role="contentinfo">` (`footer/index.tsx:91`); `role="presentation"` backdrop + `role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby aria-describedby` panel (`zimmModal/index.tsx:51-57`), with the ids supplied by the consumer and matched to real elements (`zimmSubscribeModal/index.tsx:58-59,63,78`).

**7.2 Never render a false affordance.** A control that cannot act is a non-interactive element, not a disabled button — applied twice with the same reasoning (WCAG 2.4.4 / 3.2.4): the locale placeholder renders as a `<div>` (`bottomBar/index.tsx:40-45`, and `bottomBar.css.ts:103-107` withholds `cursor`/`_focusVisible` to match), and an unusable contact channel renders as a labelled `<span>` (`zimmContactIconRow/index.tsx:76-88`). The two comments cross-reference each other.

**7.3 Perceivable-but-inert.** The fallback span keeps the icon labelled rather than `aria-hidden`, so the channel is announced — the comment at `zimmContactIconRow/index.tsx:81-83` records that a previous `aria-hidden` caused WCAG 1.1.1 information loss.

**7.4 Icon aria is enforced at the type level.** `ZimmIconProps` is a discriminated XOR: `{'aria-hidden': true; 'aria-label'?: never} | {'aria-hidden'?: never; 'aria-label': string}` (`zimmIcon/index.tsx:93`), and `role="img"` is emitted only when a label is present (`zimmIcon/index.tsx:151`). Every decorative use passes `aria-hidden={true}` explicitly: `bottomBar/index.tsx:49`, `zimmTextInput/index.tsx:116`, `zimmContactIconRow/index.tsx:73`, `zimmButton/index.tsx:51`. **All sites.**

**7.5 Cross-origin links.** `target="_blank"` + explicit `rel="noopener noreferrer"` + a WCAG 3.2.5 accessible-name suffix, applied by scheme rather than by channel name (`zimmContactIconRow/index.tsx:37,39-40,66-70`); `tel:`/`mailto:` deliberately get neither.

**7.6 Focus visibility.** `_focusVisible` with `var(--zimm-focus-ring)` (light) or a `--zimm-color-text-inverse` outline (dark), plus `outlineOffset`, in every interactive recipe: `zimmButton.css.ts:33-37,82-86,113-117,143-147,168-172,192-196`, `zimmNavItem.css.ts:58-62,66-70`, `zimmTextInput.css.ts:156-162`, `zimmContactIconRow.css.ts:27-31`, `footer.css.ts:135-139`. The footer wordmark button's reset exists specifically to restore the ring the anchor-less markup would lack (`footer.css.ts:126-128`). `zimmButton.css.ts:28-32` records that the previous `outline:none` + background swap was an actual WCAG 2.4.7 failure (`#191919` vs `#000000`).

**7.7 Target size (WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8, 24px).** `zimmTextInput.css.ts:151-154` (`minWidth`/`minHeight`), `zimmButton.css.ts:226-240` (`minW`/`minH` on the `icon` size — with the note that Chakra's `IconButton` hard-sets `padding: 0` as a style prop so any `p` here is silently discarded), `zimmContactIconRow.css.ts:11,21-22`, `zimmNavItem.css.ts:20-23` (`minHeight` as a floor, not a fixed height, so wrapped labels grow).

**7.8 Form semantics.** `htmlFor`/`id` pairing via `useId` (`zimmTextInput/index.tsx:69-71,93,97`), `aria-invalid`, computed `aria-describedby` joining helper+error ids (`zimmTextInput/index.tsx:107-108`), `role="alert"` on the error paragraph (`zimmTextInput/index.tsx:127`) and on the subscribe failure message (`zimmSubscribeSection/index.tsx:76`), `aria-live="polite"` on the subscribe state slot (`zimmSubscribeSection/index.tsx:62`), `autoComplete="email"` when `type==='email'` (`zimmTextInput/index.tsx:103`).

**7.9 Dialog keyboard mechanics** live in `useZimmModal.ts`: focus save/restore around open/close (lines 48-63), body-scroll lock restoring the *previous* value (lines 66-73), Escape (line 78), and a Tab trap with a third branch for focus that has escaped the boundary entirely — WCAG 2.1.2, cited at lines 96-102.

**7.10 Semantic markup choices are argued in comments, not assumed.** `<ul>`/`<li>` for nav links with `display:flex` on the `<li>` and the 1.5px line-box measurement behind it (`footerNavColumn.css.ts:63-69`); the contact row placed as the *last child of the list* rather than a sibling (`footerNavColumn/index.tsx:84-88`); a `<button>` rather than `<a href>` for the wordmark to mirror the header (`footer/index.tsx:120-124`); `aria-label="Zimmermann home"` at line 125; `role="img"` + `aria-label` on the inline logo SVG (`zimmLogo/index.tsx:30-31`).

**7.11 Contrast is reasoned about in the recipe.** `zimmSubscribeModal.css.ts:14-15` — `text.secondary` (#666, 5.74:1) chosen over `text.muted` (#969696), which "would fail WCAG AA 4.5:1 at 12px on the white modal panel". `zimmSubscribeSection.css.ts:55-58` — failure copy uses the coral inverse error colour so it doesn't read as success.

**7.12 Units are chosen for zoom (WCAG 1.4.4).** `footer.css.ts:6-9`, `zimmTextInput.css.ts:27-35` (a px `FIELD_CONTENT_HEIGHT` broke a rem-derived slot at 200% zoom — reserved 90px against a 53px field), `zimmSubscribeSection.css.ts:10-11`.

## 9. TOKENS

**9.1 Registered as Chakra scales:** `borderWidths`, `breakpoints`, `colors`, `fonts`, `space` (from `spacing`), `textStyles`, `components` — `overrides/app/theme/index.ts:51-62`.

**9.2 Deliberately NOT registered, with the collision table in-file:** `fontSizes`, `transition`, `sizes` — `overrides/app/theme/index.ts:31-39`. Reason: identical key names, different values, ~199 base call sites. `foundation/sizes.ts:3-7` repeats it for `iconSizes` ("Chakra's `sizes.lg` is 32rem"). Compensation is stated at `theme/index.ts:41-44`: use `textStyle` for type; import the constants directly for motion/icon/action dimensions.

**9.3 `var(--zimm-*)` is MANDATORY — not merely preferred — on any property that resolves through an unregistered scale.** Three comment sites say this in the imperative and give the failure mode:
- `zimmContactIconRow.css.ts:12-16` — "**MUST** be the CSS var, not the bare token key `'xl'` … Chakra's default `sizes.xl` is 36rem (576px) — which blew each icon up to 576px and destroyed the whole footer layout. Same rule applies to `boxSize`/`min`/`maxWidth`/`Height`."
- `zimmTextInput.css.ts:127` — `height: 'var(--zimm-scale-l)'`, "var, not `'l'`: theme.sizes has no `'l'` key"; and `:152` — "var, not `'xl'`: min-width/height resolve via theme.sizes (xl = 36rem), not theme.space".
- `zimmButton.css.ts:233-235` — same rule, cross-referencing `zimmTextInput` as "the sibling control in the same trailing slot".

**9.4 On *registered* scales, `var(--zimm-*)` is mandatory as house style rather than for correctness,** and is machine-enforced — `recipeGuards.test.ts:331-345` plus `.claude/rules/overrideStyling.md:16-27`.

**9.5 Media queries are the one sanctioned place foundation values are imported directly rather than referenced via `var()`,** because media queries cannot consume custom properties: `theme/components/footerShared.ts:9-17` imports `breakpoints.md` from `../foundation/gridSystem` and carries an `audit-allow:` note that the raw `em` is "correct and permanent here, not a placeholder awaiting a token". `BP.tabletWide` (53.75em) and `BP.desktop` (64em) have no foundation equivalent, and `desktop` deliberately differs from Chakra `lg`=62em / `xl`=80em (lines 20-21).

**9.6 A concrete colour value (not a `var()`) is required where the consumer is an SVG attribute** — `useToken('colors', ['text.inverse','text.default'])` at `zimmLogo/index.tsx:23`, with the reason at lines 21-22: "an SVG `fill` attribute needs a concrete colour value, not a custom-property reference." **One-off.**

**9.7 Missing foundation entries are compensated by a named local constant, never a bare literal, and are always labelled with the owner.** See §1.7. The standing gaps recorded: no element-level opacity token (`zimmButton.css.ts:7-11`, `zimmTextInput.css.ts:37-38`), no inverse focus-ring var (`zimmButton.css.ts:4-5`), no `4.5px` spacing entry (`zimmNavItem.css.ts:9-10`), no field-height token (`zimmTextInput.css.ts:26`), no modal-size token (`zimmSubscribeModal/index.tsx:11-13`), no logo size tokens (`zimmLogo/index.tsx:9-11`), 48px available only as the numeric alias `--zimm-scale-1200` and not as a named key (`header.ts:57-58`, `footer.css.ts:6-9`).

**9.8 Numeric `--zimm-scale-NNN` aliases exist but are the non-preferred surface.** `theme/index.ts:47-49` — "duplicates of the named scale (400 = 16px = `m`) … exist only for the `.zimm-*` global classes; the named scale is the Chakra-facing surface." Used anyway where the named key doesn't exist: `header.ts:59` (`--zimm-scale-1200`), `listMenu.ts:17,33,65,84` (`--zimm-scale-700`).

**9.9 Fonts moved from "fallback-only" to self-hosted in this PR.** Two `.woff2` added under `overrides/app/static/fonts/`; declared by `overrides/app/theme/fontFace.tsx:54-69` via a raw Emotion `<Global>` (Chakra's style processor mangles quoted font-family stacks — `fontFace.tsx:17-19`, matching the same note at `theme/index.ts:21-24`); mounted in both `_app-config/index.tsx` and `.storybook/preview.tsx` so app and Storybook cannot drift (`fontFace.tsx:20-22`). `assetRoot` deliberately reimplements two lines of `getAssetUrl` rather than importing it, with the bundling reason at `fontFace.tsx:27-40`. Only two faces because all 22 textStyles resolve to weight 400 or 500 and `fonts.body === fonts.heading` (`fontFace.tsx:14-16`). `foundation/fonts.ts:1-3` was rewritten from "not self-hosted — the Monotype licence forbids it" to "IS self-hosted", and `.claude/rules/frozenFiles.md:27-47` was rewritten accordingly, including an explicit retraction ("an earlier revision of this section claimed there was [an environment gate]").
